scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I was asked to find out how many are capable of cooking.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
他们让我调查有多少人会做饭。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
We have to try hard even though the air-raid shelter is complex and wide.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
防空洞又大又复杂，但我们还是得尽力找人。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Thanks for helping her.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
谢谢你帮她。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Is it because we helped? I thought I saw a faint smile on her face.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
是因为我们帮忙了吗？我好像看到她脸上闪过一丝微笑。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Uh?! I don't think I've seen you before in the air-raid shelter?
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
咦？我好像没在防空洞里见过你？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Ah! Are you the Adventurer who's helping with moving the newly made air cleaning unit?
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
啊！你就是那个帮忙搬运新制空气净化装置的冒险者？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
You are working a lot because of those thoughtless Mechanicians.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
那些不负责任的机械师害你忙坏了。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
The Bioengineers succeeded in cultivating grapes right?
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
听说生物工程师成功培育出葡萄了？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
They say at least one grape harvest every 2 weeks is possible? The harvest day is probably either today or tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
听说至少每两周就能收获一次。收获日应该就在今天或明天吧？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I want to taste fresh grapes soon. I've been eating only dry food for the past few days.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
真想早点尝尝新鲜葡萄。这几天我一直在吃干粮。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
There's a rumor going around in the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
防空洞里最近有个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
A while ago the Chemical Substance Specialist and a few others went outside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
不久前，化学物质专家等几个人离开过防空洞。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Apparently some contaminated substance got inside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
据说有某种受污染的物质进入了防空洞。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I heard the number of convulsing patients are rapidly increasing because of the contaminant.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
听说受到污染物影响，抽搐的病人正在迅速增加。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Ah! It's just a rumor! A Rumor!!
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
啊！这只是个传闻！只是传闻！！

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
It seems the rumor going around was true.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
看来那个传闻是真的。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I hear they are moving supplies to the clean Zone Z-2 even though it's newly opened because of the contaminant.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
听说污染物扩散后，他们正把物资转移到新开放的洁净区 Z-2。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I think I will lend a hand even just a little.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
我想我也能帮上一点忙。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Nice to meet you, my name is Bunker Sayhu.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
幸会，我叫赛胡，是防空洞的居民。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
I am sorry. Right now I am a little busy with several problems. Can we speak later?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]
抱歉，我现在正忙着处理几个问题。稍后再谈好吗？

scripts.text: No! What I mean..
scripts.translation: 不！我的意思是...

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
What?! The Adventurer wants to help me?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]
什么？！这位冒险者想帮我？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Good. The people are uncontrollable because they are shocked and confused.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]
很好。大家受到惊吓，又不知所措，已经乱成一团了。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
If the intimidating Adventurer helps out it will be easier to control the confused masses.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]
要是有你这位可靠的冒险者帮忙，安抚这些慌乱的人就容易多了。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Good!! I approve. Just in time for a troublesome problem as well.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]

scripts.text: Troublesome problem?
scripts.translation: 棘手的事？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The personnel with various specialties such as yourself have not changed their positions and are easy to grasp, but the other employees are the problem.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]
像您这样有专长的人员一直待在原岗位，情况很容易掌握。麻烦的是其他员工。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Surely they are moving according to the Emergency Situation Guidelines of their respective teams.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]
他们应该都按照各自团队的紧急情况指南行动了。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
I cannot figure out from here where they are and what they are doing.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]
可我在这里没法确认他们各自去了哪里、正在做什么。

So I was thinking if you
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

什么？葡萄？你是来送这个的？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

你是用手一颗一颗摘下来的？

scripts.text:

如果我没记错的话，她就是负责这个失败项目的人吗？

scripts.text:

Anyway!!
scripts.translation:

总之！！

scripts.text:

Not everybody is fit to be director. A headcount in this hectic situation.

不是谁都适合当总监。居然还在这种混乱的时候让人来清点人数。

scripts.text:

Wait a minute. I did a headcount and wrote it down somewhere..
scripts.translation:

等一下。我清点过人数，应该记在什么地方了...

化学物质专家总共有^FF0000{0}^000000人。该死，剩下的人也太少了。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

我们的化学物质专家和平时一样生活。在这种地方，根本没法做化学实验。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
你是冒险者吗？这里是机器仓库。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
It was originally a warehouse but it is now being used by Mechanicians to assemble machines for the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
这里原本是仓库，但现在被机械师们用来组装防空洞的机器。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

你想知道机械师的总人数吗？我想我不清楚？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Ah! Al up there might know. Go to Al.
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
啊！阿尔应该知道。去找阿尔吧。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
An adventure to move the air cleaner?
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
要去搬空气净化器吗？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
You look solid just like the other researchers mentioned. I bet you can lift the air cleaner like nothing!!
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
你看起来很壮实，其他研究员也这么说。我打赌你能轻轻松松把空气净化器抬起来！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We shouldn't be ordering people like you who got caught up in an accident, but the situation is urgent.
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
我们不该让像你这样因事故受困的人干活，但情况紧急，实在没办法。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We made a new air cleaning unit because the one operating previously broke down a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
之前那台空气净化设备坏掉了，所以我们做了一台新的。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We should have made it in modular form. Made it as one solid piece by mistake.
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
早知道就该做成模块化的，结果一不小心做成了一个整体。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Didn't think of it when we were making it!!
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
制造的时候没想到这一点！！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

我们生物工程师正竭尽全力，为避难所里的人们生产食物。

所以我们只好请冒险者来帮忙。

scripts.translation:
[生物工程师 埃布里克]
要交给设施管理员小组的改造。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
has to be delivered to Karsten of the Chemical substance team.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师 埃布里克]
要交给化学物质小组的卡斯滕。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Compensation will be paid by the people receiving the deliveries so you do not have to come back here.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师 埃布里克]
报酬由接收货物的人支付，所以您不必回到这里。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
I thought I told you don't have to come back. Anyway how did you get inside?
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师 埃布里克]
我不是说过不用回来吗？算了，你是怎么进来的？

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
We Bioengineers are doing all we can to produce food for the people inside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师 埃布里克]
我们生物工程师正在竭尽全力，为防空洞内的人们生产食物。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Sorry. Did you wait long? There are a lot of suspected infection patients as you can see..
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
抱歉，让你久等了吧？你也看到了，疑似感染的病人很多...

scripts.text: Not really..
scripts.translation: 没有很久..

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Eh?! You didn't wait? That's strange? Did you cut in line? Cutting is bad.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
咦？！你没等吗？真奇怪。你插队了？插队可不好。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
As you know there are infectees who are suddenly showing strange phenomena..
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
你也知道，有些感染者会突然出现奇怪的症状...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Um...
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
...Ah...
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
...啊...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
...Oh!!
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
...哦！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
I don't see any problematic symptoms. Fortunate.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
我没发现什么异常症状。还好。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
We are having trouble because of the suddenly convulsing patients.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
那些突然抽搐的病人让我们忙得不可开交。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Look here. My skin is getting crispy from not being able to sleep for days~
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
你看，我好几天没睡觉，皮肤都快干裂了~

scripts.text: Thudunk!! Babang!! Crash!!
scripts.translation: 咚！砰！撞击！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Yes.. Just like that
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
是的...就像那样

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
... ...
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
... ...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Argh!! Another convulsing patient.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
啊！！又有病人抽搐了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Hey. Aren't you an adventurer? You must be really strong.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
喂，你是冒险者吧？一定很强。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Can you suppress that convulsing patient? I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
能帮忙制伏那个抽搐的病人吗？拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
You didn't get bit or scratched by the convulsing patient, did you?
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
你没被那个抽搐的病人咬伤或抓伤吧？

scripts.text: Why?
scripts.translation: 为什么？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Hmm~ I don't see any particular wounds.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
嗯~ 我没看到什么特别的伤口。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Since I can't figure out the infection route...
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
既然还查不出感染途径...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
We have to prepare for a possible disaster...
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
我们就得为可能发生的灾难做好准备...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Anyway, Adventurer~ Assuring and the best!
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
总之，冒险者就是可靠又能干！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
I haven't been that bewildered by simultaneously convulsing patients before..
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
以前从未遇到过这么多病人同时抽搐的情况...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Lucky you were here to suppress it with ease.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
幸好你在这里，轻松就压制住了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
I am sorry but can you report this to Fresa on your way? You know who Fresa is?
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
抱歉，你能顺路把情况报告给弗雷萨吗？你知道弗雷萨是谁吧？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
It is a situation so I am asking you a favor.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
情况紧急，只好拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Ee~~ ee~ ek~~~~~~~~~!!

[Nurse Lapplad]
Take those patients down quickly! You're an adventurer!!
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
快把那些病人制伏！你可是冒险者啊！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
I am sorry but can you report this to Fresa on your way? This is a favor.
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
抱歉，能顺路把情况报告给弗雷萨吗？拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Strange? How did you get in here? You should be prohibited access..
scripts.translation:
[护士 拉普拉德]
真奇怪，你是怎么进来的？这里应该禁止入内...

scripts.text:
[Patient]
Hurts.. It hurts..
scripts.translation:
[病人]
好痛...好痛...

scripts.text:
[Patient]
I'm fine. They're making a fuss for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[病人]
我没事。他们只是在小题大做。

scripts.text:
[Patient]
I keep feeling sleepy for some reason. Is it because I'm sick?
scripts.translation:
[病人]
不知道为什么一直犯困。是因为生病了吗？

scripts.text:
[Patient]
My head feels blank.. Uh? Did you say something?
scripts.translation:
[病人]
脑子一片空白...嗯？你刚才说什么？

scripts.text:
[Patient]
Ugh.. Feels like my whole body is cramped.
scripts.translation:
[病人]
呃...感觉全身都抽筋了。

scripts.text:
[Patient]
Urk.. I feel sick even though I didn't drink.
scripts.translation:
[病人]
呕...明明没喝酒，却觉得恶心。

scripts.text:
[Patient]
Oh no is there a transfectant found in me..
scripts.translation:
[病人]
糟了，我不会是感染者吧...

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
We used to deliver things like daily necessities or research tools here before the accident.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
事故之前，我们曾在这里运送生活必需品和研究工具。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Work that involved going out to other places a lot more even as a staff member here.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
以前我们这里的职员也经常要外出办事。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
What?! Is something going on? The Mechanicians and Facilities managers look busy.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
什么？出什么事了？机械师和设施管理员看起来都很忙。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Yaa~ Did you try the grapes?
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
呀~你尝过葡萄了吗？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Isn't it great that we can grow fresh grapes in an underground evacuation facility like this?
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
能在这样的地下避难所里种出新鲜葡萄，不是很棒吗？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Some people are suddenly attacking others.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
有些人突然开始攻击别人。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
What in the hell is going on?
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
到底是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
They were talking about it in the broadcast since yesterday so you know the gist of the situation, right?
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
从昨天起广播就在说这件事，你应该知道大致情况吧？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
The contaminant is getting to the interior of the air-raid shelter so the decision has been made to move all supplies to the uncontaminated zone Z-2 that the Chemical Substance Specialists found.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
污染物已经渗入避难所内部，因此决定把所有物资转移到化学物质专家发现的未污染区域Z-2。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
There was a request to move the cargo with the Adventurers since the scrawny researchers won't be of help.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
研究员们身材瘦弱，帮不上忙，所以有人提议让冒险者来搬运货物。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Alright- let's move the cargo to Zone Z-2 first.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
好，先把货物搬到Z-2区。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
If you go to the machine Warehouse on your way back there will a person called Al. Tell him
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
回去时顺道去机器仓库找阿尔，告诉他：

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
^0000FFYou idiots!! Stop wasting material with stupid machines!!^000000.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
^0000FF你们这群白痴！！别再用那些愚蠢的机器浪费材料了！！^000000。

scripts.text: Eh?
scripts.translation: 诶？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Don't understand? Tell Al in the machine Warehouse
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
没听懂吗？去机器仓库告诉阿尔：

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
^0000FFYou idiots!! Stop wasting material with stupid machines!!^000000.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
^0000FF你们这群白痴！！别再用那些愚蠢的机器浪费材料了！！^000000。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Remember to get every postposition right and convey my feeling 100%.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
记得把每个助词都用对，百分之百传达我的语气。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Transport the cargo to Zone Z-2 first.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
先把货物运到Z-2区。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
On your way back go to the machine Warehouse and tell Al
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
回去时去机器仓库找阿尔，告诉他：

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
^0000FF You idiots!! Stop wasting material with stupid machines!!^000000?? for me and come back.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
^0000FF你们这群白痴！！别再用那些愚蠢的机器浪费材料了！！^000000？替我传达这句话，然后回来。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Did you deliver the goods to Zone Z-2?
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
货物送到Z-2区了吗？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Oh! Wasn't there one more thing I requested? Did you send the message to the Mechanicians?
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
哦！我是不是还托你办了件事？你给机械师传话了吗？

scripts.text: Not yet..
scripts.translation: 还没...

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Ah.. What should I do.. Should I go since most of the goods are moved?
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
啊...我该怎么办...货物大多搬完了，我是不是该亲自去一趟？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
If I leave it like this those idiots who know nothing outside of machines might do something with the precious components...
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
要是放任不管，那群只懂机器的白痴说不定会糟蹋那些珍贵零件...

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
What should we do? Should I go? Or do you want to go back?
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
怎么办？我去，还是你回去一趟？

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text: Do not go back.
scripts.translation: 不用回去

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Alright. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
好，那你回去一趟吧。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Yeah? I guess the machine Warehouse is kind of far.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
是吗？看来机器仓库确实挺远的。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Since we're almost done here I will finish up quickly and go. This is compensation for the work.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
这里的工作差不多结束了，我赶紧收尾就过去。这是给你的报酬。

scripts.text: - The small round capsule has percolated through skin. It feels like experience has accumulated.
scripts.translation: - 小圆胶囊渗入皮肤，感觉经验值增加了。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Though our survival isn't sure because of the contaminant,
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
虽然污染物让我们的生存状况难以预料，

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
The chief researcher told us to adequately compensate the adventurers who were caught up in the explosion.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
首席研究员还是指示我们，要妥善补偿那些意外卷入爆炸的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Don't worry about it though.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
不过你不用担心。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
You conveyed my feeling right?
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
你把我的语气传达到了吧？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
They should be smartened up by now. They wouldn't waste precious components again, right?
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
他们现在应该长记性了吧？总不会再浪费珍贵零件了吧？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Here! This is compensation for the job.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
给，这是你的报酬。

scripts.text: - The small round capsule has percolated through skin. It feels like experience has accumulated.
scripts.translation: - 小圆胶囊渗入皮肤，感觉经验值增加了。

scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
虽然污染物让我们的生存状况难以预料，

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Don't worry about it though.
scripts.translation:

不过你不用担心。

Though our survival isn't sure because of the contaminant,
scripts.translation:

虽然污染物让我们的生存状况难以预料，

scripts.text:

The chief researcher told us to adequately compensate the adventurers who were caught up in the explosion.
scripts.translation:

首席研究员还是指示我们，要妥善补偿那些意外卷入爆炸的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Don't worry about it though.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管 埃农]
不过你不用担心。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
It is a relief we were able to evacuate to the air-raid shelter interior in advance.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫兰迪]
幸好我们提前撤进了避难所内部。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
If we weren't able to evacuate..? We probably won't be here.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫兰迪]
要是没能及时撤离...我们恐怕就没命了。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
Is there something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫兰迪]
有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
A while ago the Facilities managers were running around in haste.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫兰迪]
刚才设施管理员们急匆匆地跑来跑去。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
What in the world?! You ate fresh grapes? Why didn't I get to eat them? Why?
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫兰迪]
什么？！你吃到新鲜葡萄了？为什么我没吃到？为什么啊？

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
This place is sure quiet. Why you ask?
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫兰迪]
这里真安静。你问为什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
Not many people come this far.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫兰迪]
很少有人会走到这么远的地方。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
Ah! Come on in. It seems there are a lot of visitors today because of the broadcast this morning.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫兰迪]
啊！进来吧。看来今天早上的广播引来了不少访客。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
You're here because Ernon sent you right?
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫兰迪]
你是埃农派来的吧？

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
I have received the item you have brought.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫兰迪]
你带来的东西我收到了。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
Eh-? Are you taking it back? That is a lot of work.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫兰迪]
咦？你要把东西拿回去？那可够麻烦的。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
You are going through a lot.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫兰迪]
真是辛苦你了。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续任务 -

scripts.text:
[Dimensional Device]
Do you want finish your travels and
go back to your original time?
^FF0000All traces in this place will be erased if you go back to your original time.^000000
scripts.translation:
[次元装置]
要结束这趟旅程，回到原来的时间吗？
^FF0000回到原来的时间后，这里留下的一切痕迹都会消失。^000000

scripts.text: Stay here.
scripts.translation: 留在这里。

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text:
[Dimensional Device]
Your whole body becomes heavy and time seems to be passing faster around you.
scripts.translation:
[次元装置]
你感到浑身沉重，周围的时间似乎流逝得更快了。

scripts.text: A mysteriously intense driving energy can be felt from this device.
scripts.translation: 这个装置散发出一股神秘而强烈的驱动力。

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text: Pull it
scripts.translation: 拉动它

scripts.text: The surrounding distortion of time seems to be returning to normal.
scripts.translation: 周围扭曲的时间似乎正在恢复正常。

scripts.text: This device's use cannot be figured out.
scripts.translation: 无法弄清楚这个装置的用途。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
You're conducting a headcount?
scripts.translation:
[机械师 布卡尔]
你在清点人数吗？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I am not sure. Maybe you can ask Al over there?
scripts.translation:
[机械师 布卡尔]
我不太确定。也许你可以问问那边的阿尔？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I mean the air cleaning unit you are moving now.
scripts.translation:
[机械师 布卡尔]
我说的是你现在正在搬的那台空气净化设备。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I made that. Isn't it awesome?
scripts.translation:
[机械师 布卡尔]
那是我做的，厉害吧？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
Ah!! You're the adventurer. You could check out the farm.
scripts.translation:
[机械师 布卡尔]
啊！你是冒险者吧？可以去农场看看。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
Isn't the farm good because it's warm? I made the temperature control device there. Isn't it awesome?
scripts.translation:
[机械师 布卡尔]
农场很暖和，不错吧？里面的温控设备是我做的，厉害吧？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I am worried of the people suddenly attacking.
scripts.translation:
[机械师 布卡尔]
我担心大家会突然互相攻击。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
Since we're already here should I make something like a patient suppression device?
scripts.translation:
[机械师 布卡尔]
既然都到这地步了，我是不是该做个能制伏病人的装置？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I don't know why everybody is rejecting a device that can move heavy objects.
scripts.translation:
[机械师 布卡尔]
我不明白大家为什么都反对制造搬运重物的装置。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I should have made one when they were making new air cleaning units..
scripts.translation:
[机械师 布卡尔]
早知道他们要造新的空气净化设备时，我就该做一个了...

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
Ugh.. I want to make something.
scripts.translation:
[机械师 布卡尔]
唉...我真想做点什么。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Who is that woman to conduct a headcount as if she's the leader?
scripts.translation:
[研究员 格鲁姆]
那个女人是谁？怎么像个领袖似的清点人数？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
There wouldn't have been an explosion if there was no experiment the first place? Right?
scripts.translation:
[研究员 格鲁姆]
要是一开始没有那场实验，不就不会发生爆炸了吗？对吧？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
I think the self-righteous and haggardly Fresa has changed.
scripts.translation:
[研究员 格鲁姆]
那个自以为是、面容憔悴的弗雷萨好像变了。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
She's become more warm compared to the past, right?
scripts.translation:
[研究员 格鲁姆]
和以前相比，她待人更和善了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Fresa has definitely changed a lot.
scripts.translation:
[研究员 格鲁姆]
弗蕾萨确实变了很多。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Today she is handing out grapes to people. In the past that would have been unimaginable.
scripts.translation:
[研究员 格鲁姆]
今天她还在给大家发葡萄。放在以前，简直不可想象。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Why is that Fresa acting like the leader alone but still hasn't taken measures?
scripts.translation:
[研究员 格鲁姆]
弗雷萨为什么像个领袖似的独断专行，却迟迟不采取措施？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Measures need to taken about the convulsing patients. Are you going to cover this up like in the past?
scripts.translation:
[研究员 格鲁姆]
必须处理那些抽搐的病人。你们还想像以前那样把事情瞒下来吗？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
So this is what's happening?
scripts.translation:
[研究员 格鲁姆]
原来是这么回事？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
I should have known when she tried to half-ass things.
scripts.translation:
[研究员 格鲁姆]
她之前敷衍了事的时候，我就该想到会出问题。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
I really don't like self-righteous and hypocritical Fresa.
scripts.translation:
[研究员 格鲁姆]
我真讨厌弗雷萨那副自以为是、虚伪的样子。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
Uh?! You're an adventurer too?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 让]
咦？！你也是冒险者？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
Ugh.. It seems you are unlucky as well.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 让]
唉...看来你的运气也不怎么样。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
Don't you think this place is trying to exploit us Adventurers?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 让]
你不觉得这里在压榨我们这些冒险者吗？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
The Cafeteria food is good though.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 让]
不过食堂的饭菜倒是不错。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
Grapes were served on the side today.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 让]
今天还配了葡萄。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
I like grapes. I want to eat more.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 让]
我喜欢葡萄，还想再多吃点。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
A friend I made here is confined in the temporary clinic. They found a transfectant or something.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 让]
我在这里交的一个朋友被关进了临时诊所。他们说他感染了什么东西之类的。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
To us adventurers a healthy body is an asset.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 让]
对我们冒险者来说，健康的身体就是本钱。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
I ate a lot of different things from adventuring places.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 让]
我在冒险途中尝过各种各样的东西。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
I think the food here is one of the best.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 让]
我觉得这里的饭菜算得上数一数二。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
I ate a lot of different things from adventuring places.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 让]
我在冒险途中尝过各种各样的东西。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
I think the food here is one of the best.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 让]
我觉得这里的饭菜算得上数一数二。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Sorry. We aren't ready to distribute food yet.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
抱歉。我们还没准备好分发食物。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Grab a plate or tray and wait in line.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
拿个盘子或托盘，然后排队等候。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Oh no what should we do? We ran out of grapes.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
糟了，怎么办？葡萄已经吃完了。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
New grapes should be delivered from the farm soon. Do you want to wait?
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
农场很快就会送来新葡萄。你要等一会儿吗？

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Do you know that's the temporary clinic? You cannot go that way now.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
你知道那边是临时诊所吧？现在不能从那里通行。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
The passage is blocked because of convulsing patients.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
抽搐的病人堵住了通道。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
You are working hard.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
您辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Grab a plate or tray and wait in line.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
拿个盘子或托盘，然后排队等候。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Ahh.. Why did I travel here..
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 布里辛]
唉...我为什么要来这里...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Hey don't think of going out that way. It's going to be dangerous because of the explosion.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 布里辛]
喂，别想从那边出去。爆炸后外面很危险。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Today is strange. Hey do you see the mysterious device over there too?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 布里辛]
今天真奇怪。嘿，你也看到那边那个神秘装置了吗？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
I think I said it 30 times today alone but there is no device at the door.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 布里辛]
我今天光这句话就说了30遍了，可门口根本没有什么装置。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
I am itching for an adventure but safety outside isn't confirmed so don't think of going outside.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 布里辛]
我也很想出去冒险，但外面的安全状况还没确认，别想着出去了。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
A while I ago I couldn't stop the Chemical Substance Specialists from going outside.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 布里辛]
刚才我没能拦住那些化学物质专家出门。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Seeing how they didn't return, they must be dead, right?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 布里辛]
他们一直没回来，肯定已经死了吧？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
The situation has grown out of control.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 布里辛]
局势已经失控了。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Haa- Should have I stopped those people leaving the air-raid shelter?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 布里辛]
唉——我当初是不是该拦住那些离开避难所的人？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Today is strange. Hey do you see the mysterious device over there too?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 布里辛]
今天真奇怪。嘿，你也看到那边那个神秘装置了吗？

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
You cannot enter this area because it is under construction.
scripts.translation:
[门禁守卫]
该区域正在施工，禁止进入。

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
According to the Facilities managers it will be later used as a Clinic.
scripts.translation:
[门禁守卫]
据设施管理员说，这里之后会改成诊所。

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
You cannot enter this area because it is under construction.
scripts.translation:
[门禁守卫]
该区域正在施工，禁止进入。

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
According to the Facilities managers it will be later used as a Clinic.
scripts.translation:
[门禁守卫]
据设施管理员说，这里之后会改成诊所。

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
You cannot enter this area because it is under construction.
scripts.translation:
[门禁守卫]
该区域正在施工，禁止进入。

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
According to the Facilities managers it will be later used as a Clinic.
scripts.translation:
[门禁守卫]
据设施管理员说，这里之后会改成诊所。

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
Access to the temporary clinic is restricted to quarantine convulsing patients.
scripts.translation:
[门禁守卫]
临时诊所目前只收治需要隔离的抽搐病人。

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
I ask for your understanding.
scripts.translation:
[门禁守卫]
感谢您的理解。

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
Access to the temporary clinic is restricted to quarantine convulsing patients.
scripts.translation:
[门禁守卫]
临时诊所目前只收治需要隔离的抽搐病人。

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
I ask for your understanding.
scripts.translation:
[门禁守卫]
感谢您的理解。

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
Movement in this area is currently prohibited.
scripts.translation:
[门禁守卫]
目前禁止在这一区域走动。

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
I ask for your understanding.
scripts.translation:
[门禁守卫]
感谢您的理解。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
Aah- I don't know the reason but the control room is
scripts.translation:
[设施管理员 吉科]
唉——我也不知道为什么，控制室

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
is damaged a lot. At this point it isn't a control room but a warehouse.
scripts.translation:
[设施管理员 吉科]
已经严重损坏了。与其说是控制室，现在更像个仓库。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
Ah the air cleaning unit doesn't belong here.
scripts.translation:
[设施管理员 吉科]
啊，空气净化设备不该放在这里。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
If my memory is correct, you have to deliver them to Zones C-0, F-1, F-2, I-0, Z-0.
scripts.translation:
[设施管理员 吉科]
如果我没记错，你得把设备送到C-0、F-1、F-2、I-0和Z-0区。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
Haa- I have been cleaning the Control room for several days now
scripts.translation:
[设施管理员 吉科]
唉——我已经清理控制室好几天了。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
This place cannot be organized no matter how I much organize it. I guess we should just use it for storage.
scripts.translation:
[设施管理员 吉科]
这里怎么整理都收拾不干净。我看还是当仓库用吧。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
Come on in. Welcome to the Warehouse.
scripts.translation:
[设施管理员 吉科]
请进，欢迎来到仓库。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
Urrghh
scripts.translation:
[设施管理员 吉科]
呃啊...

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
This is not the control room.
scripts.translation:
[设施管理员 吉科]
这里不是控制室。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager Jiko]
It's the warehouse!!
scripts.translation:
[设施管理员 吉科]
这里是仓库！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Patient~ That chair is quite high.. doesn't your head ache?
scripts.translation:
[护士]
病人~那把椅子挺高的...你不觉得头疼吗？

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Why does he say he has a cramp? The other patients didn't have that problem.
scripts.translation:
[护士]
他为什么说自己抽筋了？其他病人可没这个问题。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Argh- I told you not to scribble on the floor while pretending to sleep.
scripts.translation:
[护士]
啊——我告诉过你，假装睡觉的时候不要在地板上涂鸦。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
You ran around the elephant trunk thirty times so you must be sick. Claiming he can't feel dizziness. Quite the bluffer.
scripts.translation:
[护士]
你绕着象鼻跑了三十圈，肯定是生病了。还说自己一点都不晕，真能吹。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Ah geez! There is no other issues yet but why is he saying he's dizzy?
scripts.translation:
[护士]
哎呀！目前还没发现其他问题，可他为什么说自己头晕？

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
So what do you mean!! Where does it hurt!!
scripts.translation:
[护士]
你到底在说什么！！哪里疼！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
What do you mean nothing is wrong, your face has gone purple.
scripts.translation:
[护士]
你说没事，但你的脸都发紫了。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
It seems we can harvest grape tree number 1 without problems. What a relief.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师]
看来1号葡萄树可以顺利收获了。真是松了口气。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
My heart sank when the Mechanicians destroyed a tree..
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师]
机械师毁掉一棵树时，我的心都沉了下去...

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
The soil grape tree number 2 is in seems to be lacking nutrition.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师]
2号葡萄树所在的土壤好像缺少养分。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
We need to prepare fertilizer to provide the soil more nutrition.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师]
我们得准备些肥料，给土壤补充养分。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
I worried because a lot of weird stuff was growing around grape tree number 3.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师]
3号葡萄树周围长了很多奇怪的东西，害我担心了好一阵。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
It seems the harvest will have no problem.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师]
看来收获不会有问题。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
Grape tree number 4 has no particular problem.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师]
4号葡萄树没有特别的问题。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
Nutrition state good. Harvest state good.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师]
养分状况良好，收成状况也良好。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
The nutrition of grape tree number 5 is too good.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师]
5号葡萄树的养分太充足了。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer]
That doesn't mean there will be a higher harvest yield..
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师]
不过，这不代表收成会更好...

scripts.text: There is a Memory Record somebody is recording.
scripts.translation: 有人正在录制记忆记录。

scripts.text: Listen.
scripts.translation: 听。

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Ah ah- One two three test- test-
scripts.translation: 啊啊——一、二、三，测试——测试——

scripts.text: To distinguish survival days in the air-raid shelter, today will be designated Explosion Day 1 after the experiment explosion.
scripts.translation: 为了记录大家在避难所里的生存天数，今天定为实验爆炸后的第1天。

scripts.text: Everybody fell into panic after seeing the outside situation on the monitor after the explosion.
scripts.translation: 爆炸后，大家从监视器上看到外面的情况，全都陷入了恐慌。

scripts.text: But chief researcher Dr. Fresa calmly consoled everybody and checked how many survived.
scripts.translation: 但首席研究员弗雷萨博士冷静地安抚了大家，并清点了幸存者人数。

scripts.text: The final number of survivors including adventurers seems to be 326.
scripts.translation: 包括冒险者在内，最终幸存者似乎共有326人。

scripts.text: The camera showing outside was damaged in the afternoon. It seems we cannot see the situation outside anymore.
scripts.translation: 下午，用来监视外面的摄像头坏了。看来我们再也看不到外面的情况了。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 录音到此为止。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再听一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 2
scripts.translation: 实验爆炸后的第2天

scripts.text: A witch hunt against the director and chief researcher Fresa began.
scripts.translation: 针对总监兼首席研究员弗雷萨的批斗开始了。

scripts.text: My opinion is different. The research and experiment was conducted under her direction but this is an accident.
scripts.translation: 我的看法不同。研究和实验虽然都是在她的主持下进行的，但这只是一次事故。

scripts.text: If not Fresa, they would have made somebody else to blame.
scripts.translation: 就算不是弗雷萨，他们也会找别人来背锅。

scripts.text: But she is handling it in a dignified manner despite concerns.
scripts.translation: 尽管众人对她有诸多质疑，她仍从容应对。

scripts.text: She says problem solving is more important than blame and is checking assignments of survivors before the accident.
scripts.translation: 她说解决问题比追究责任更重要，正在重新确认事故发生前幸存者的工作安排。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 3
scripts.translation: 实验爆炸后的第3天

scripts.text: Fresa.. She naturally became the leader of the survivors.
scripts.translation: 弗雷萨...她自然而然地成了幸存者们的领袖。

scripts.text: There was no vote of sorts, but nobody is complaining about her being the leader.
scripts.translation: 虽然没有进行投票，但没有人对她担任首领提出异议。

scripts.text: The day before she had a briefing on the situation of the total survivors.
scripts.translation: 前一天，她听取了全体幸存者的情况简报。

scripts.text:
20 Bioengineers
16 Mechanicians
27 Facilities managers
10 Chemical Substance Specialists
Other than specialists the assignments of survivors such as cafeteria staff, janitors, gardeners, distribution directors, health professionals, adventurers caught in the accident have been assessed.
scripts.translation:
20名生物工程师
16名机械师
27名设施管理员
10名化学物质专家
此外，我们还统计了其他幸存者的分工，包括食堂员工、清洁工、园丁、配送主管、医护人员，以及意外卷入事故的冒险者。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 4
scripts.translation: 实验爆炸后的第4天

scripts.text: Everybody's work has been decided based on Fresa's briefing the day before.
scripts.translation: 所有人的工作都根据弗雷萨前一天的简报安排妥当。

scripts.text: It was decided that researchers including myself know nothing much research and must continue our lives in the air-raid shelter under the guidance of those who have technical skill needed for survival.
scripts.translation: 包括我在内的研究员对许多事情都不甚了解，因此决定由掌握生存所需技能的人带领我们，继续在避难所里生活。

scripts.text: First the Chemical Substance Specialists and Facilities managers started to install Air Contamination Gauge Sensors in the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation: 首先，化学物质专家和设施管理员开始在避难所内安装空气污染监测传感器。

scripts.text: After evaluating that oxygen levels were low the Mechanicians have started to assemble Air cleaning units.
scripts.translation: 确认氧气含量偏低后，机械师们开始组装空气净化设备。

scripts.text: Lora, a former cafeteria employee was consulted on the important problem of food.
scripts.translation: 食物是个大问题，于是大家请教了前食堂员工洛拉。

scripts.text: We assessed that about 40 days of survival is possible based on the food in the warehouse and the number of survivors.
scripts.translation: 根据仓库里的食物储备和幸存者人数，我们估算这些食物大约能支撑40天。

scripts.text: This prompted the Bioengineers to cultivate plants that can self-produce.
scripts.translation: 于是，生物工程师开始培育能够自行繁殖的植物。

scripts.text: Other miscellaneous assignments were issued under Fresa's direction.
scripts.translation: 弗雷萨还安排了其他各种杂务。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 5
scripts.translation: 实验爆炸后的第5天

scripts.text: I don't know the details but the air pollution level outside of the shelter was measured.
scripts.translation: 具体情况我不清楚，只知道有人测量了避难所外的空气污染程度。

scripts.text: According to the Chemical Substance Specialists the situation is hopeless.
scripts.translation: 化学物质专家说，外面的情况已经无可挽回。

scripts.text: It seems life in the air-raid shelter has to continue longer. Just can quietly keep working..
scripts.translation: 看来我们还得在避难所里待很久。只能继续默默工作...

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 21
scripts.translation: 实验爆炸后的第21天

scripts.text: After silently working for several days the Bioengineers have good news.
scripts.translation: 生物工程师们默默工作了几天后，终于带来了好消息。

scripts.text: They have succeeded in artificially germinating a plant that can self-produce.
scripts.translation: 他们成功人工培育出了一种能够自行繁殖的植物。

scripts.text: Fortunately the air-raid shelter has a warehouse spacious enough to grow plants in.
scripts.translation: 幸好避难所里有个足够宽敞的仓库，可以用来种植。

scripts.text: It seems we can forget about our food problem now.
scripts.translation: 看来食物问题总算解决了。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 30
scripts.translation: 实验爆炸后的第30天

scripts.text: A small problem has occurred in the air-raid shelter. The air cleaning units made in the beginning are broken.
scripts.translation: 避难所里出了点小问题：最初制造的空气净化设备坏了。

scripts.text: Fortunately there will be no problem maintaining oxygen concentration levels thanks to the air cleaning units the Mechanicians made without approval.
scripts.translation: 幸好机械师们未经批准就制造了新的空气净化设备，因此氧气浓度仍能维持在安全水平。

scripts.text: They are too heavy so adventurers were deployed because nobody else is able to move them.
scripts.translation: 新设备太重，其他人都搬不动，只能派冒险者去搬。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 录音到此为止。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再听一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 32
scripts.translation: 实验爆炸后的第32天

scripts.text: Today is the first harvest of the grape tree cultivated by the Bioengineers.
scripts.translation: 今天是生物工程师培育的葡萄树首次收获的日子。

scripts.text: Although there was a small problem of the Mechanicians destroying one grape tree
scripts.translation: 虽然机械师弄坏了一棵葡萄树，出了点小插曲，

scripts.text: The air-raid shelter residents are throwing a small party to celebrate the successful harvest.
scripts.translation: 避难所的居民还是办了个小型派对，庆祝成功收获葡萄。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 录音到此为止。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再听一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 38
scripts.translation: 实验爆炸后的第38天

scripts.text: Chemical Substance Specialists and some Adventurers sick of living in the air-raid shelter have left the shelter to measure the air.
scripts.translation: 一些受够了避难所生活的化学物质专家和冒险者离开避难所，去测量外面的空气。

scripts.text: They have not returned by evening.
scripts.translation: 直到傍晚，他们都没有回来。

scripts.text: Was the freedom of outside better than the life in the dark air-raid shelter?
scripts.translation: 难道外面的自由，比在黑暗避难所里的生活更好吗？

scripts.text: After midnight the remaining Chemical Substance Specialists assessed that they were dead and everybody had a brief moment of silence.
scripts.translation: 午夜过后，剩下的化学物质专家认定他们已经遇难，大家为他们默哀了片刻。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 40
scripts.translation: 实验爆炸后的第40天

scripts.text: A dark rumor is going around the shelter.
scripts.translation: 避难所里开始流传一个不祥的传闻。

scripts.text: There is a rumor that a contaminant from the outside has invaded the air-raid shelter because of the people who left a while ago.
scripts.translation: 有人说，之前离开的人把外面的污染物带进了避难所。

scripts.text: Is it because of the contaminant? There are patients who suddenly convulse and attack others.
scripts.translation: 是污染物造成的吗？有些病人会突然抽搐，还会攻击别人。

scripts.text: Under the leader Fresa's decision, everybody was checked and those found with transfectants were quarantined in the temporary clinic.
scripts.translation: 在首领弗雷萨的决定下，所有人都接受了检查；体内发现感染体的人被隔离在临时诊所。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 录音到此为止。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再听一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 43
scripts.translation: 实验爆炸后的第43天

scripts.text: The rumor in the air-raid shelter has come true.
scripts.translation: 避难所里的传闻成真了。

scripts.text: The remaining Chemical Substance Specialists have confirmed that the contaminant is eroding into the air-raid shelter
scripts.translation: 剩下的化学物质专家确认，污染物正在侵入避难所内部。

scripts.text: And Fresa and experts have started taking measures.
scripts.translation: 弗雷萨和专家们已经开始采取措施。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 45
scripts.translation: 实验爆炸后的第45天

scripts.text: The invading contaminant will not stop.
scripts.translation: 入侵的污染物没有停止扩散。

scripts.text: It has been decided to move all equipment and necessities to the less contaminated Zone Z-2
scripts.translation: 大家决定把所有设备和必需品都转移到污染较轻的Z-2区。

scripts.text: And facility managers have started to install a partition in Zone Z-0 to prevent the contaminant from coming in further.
scripts.translation: 设施管理员们开始在Z-0区安装隔离墙，阻止污染物继续侵入。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 录音到此为止。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再听一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: The mechanical device thrown on the floor cannot be determined if it is still operable.
scripts.translation: 扔在地上的机械装置，不知道还能不能用。

scripts.text: There is a Memory Record somebody is recording.
scripts.translation: 有人正在录制记忆音盘。

scripts.text: Listen.
scripts.translation: 听。

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Oh- Is this a memory record? Does it work? Oh it works. Works! Should I try it since I'm bored?
scripts.translation: 哦，这是记忆音盘吗？还能用吗？好像能用。真能用！反正闲着也是闲着，要不听听？

scripts.text: My name is Maso an Adventurer traveling the world. Today is 4th day of entering the air-raid shelter? 3rd day? The vibe here is weird and hard to adjust to.
scripts.translation: 我叫马索，是个周游世界的冒险者。今天是进避难所的第4天？还是第3天？这里气氛怪怪的，真让人不习惯。

scripts.text: Verus city has Adventurers amongst its original population but the treatment towards Adventurers is strangely good.
scripts.translation: 维鲁斯城的原住民中也有冒险者，不过他们对冒险者好得有些反常。

scripts.text: The mood is that Adventurers are people caught up in an uncontrollable accident and need to be treated well.
scripts.translation: 大家似乎觉得，冒险者只是意外卷入这场无法控制的事故，应该好好对待。

scripts.text: As an Adventurer who eats and plays as much as he works, I cannot stand the itching for action. Urgh
scripts.translation: 我这种平时吃吃喝喝、到处冒险的家伙，真受不了这股无处发泄的劲。唉。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Is today day 6? Details aren't told to Adventurers so I am not sure but the people of Verus city seem very gloomy.
scripts.translation: 今天是第6天吗？冒险者得不到太多消息，我也不确定。不过维鲁斯城的人看起来都很沮丧。

scripts.text: The Adventurer's blood is boiling and wanting to explore places but there isn't much to do.
scripts.translation: 我这个冒险者浑身热血沸腾，恨不得出去探索，可这里根本没什么事可做。

scripts.text: I looked around the air-raid shelter but whoever designed it has not one artistic hair on him.
scripts.translation: 我在避难所里四处看了看，设计这里的人恐怕一点艺术细胞都没有。

scripts.text: It is no fun to keep looking at the same hallways and same room lay outs.
scripts.translation: 每天看着同样的走廊和房间布局，实在无聊。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Is today day 21? The Verus City people look happy to have solved the food problem.
scripts.translation: 今天是第21天吗？食物问题解决了，维鲁斯城的人看起来很高兴。

scripts.text: It is cute to see the mild looking researchers going around cheering and screaming.
scripts.translation: 看着那些平时温文尔雅的研究员到处欢呼尖叫，还挺可爱的。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: The 30th night but because it's always dark I don't really know if it's night or day. I just ate supper so it must be night.
scripts.translation: 今天是第30个夜晚。不过这里总是黑漆漆的，我也分不清白天黑夜。刚吃过晚饭，应该是晚上吧。

scripts.text: Today I moved the really heavy air cleaning units made by the Mechanicians with the other Adventurers.
scripts.translation: 今天我和其他冒险者一起，搬动了机械师们制造的那些非常沉重的空气净化装置。

scripts.text: The air-raid shelter is so large that I had no idea where they were but thanks to that I became friends with some of the Adventurers, especially Castle and Blat.
scripts.translation: 避难所太大了，我根本不知道他们把设备搬去了哪里。不过这次倒让我结识了几位冒险者，尤其是卡斯尔和布拉特。

scripts.text: By the way the Mechanicians seem to have mental problems. They make a ruckus for not being able to make machines and got dragged out by the guards.
scripts.translation: 顺便一提，机械师们好像有点不对劲。他们因为没法制造机器而大吵大闹，最后被卫兵拖走了。

scripts.text: The Mechanicians are definitely going to cause trouble someday.
scripts.translation: 机械师们迟早会惹出麻烦。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 没有更多的录音内容了。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再听一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Today is day 32 and I worked on the grape harvest.
scripts.translation: 今天是第32天，我去帮忙采收葡萄了。

scripts.text: I ate fresh grapes and since I don't have anything to do anything to do, I'm going to sleep early.
scripts.translation: 我吃了新鲜葡萄，反正也没什么事可做，就早点睡吧。

scripts.text: Ah.. the grape was good, I want it again. Did they say harvest was possible once every 2 weeks?
scripts.translation: 啊...葡萄真好吃，还想再吃。听说每两周就能收获一次？

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 没有更多的录音内容了。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再听一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Today is the 38th day of being in the shelter and there is a fuss since the morning.
scripts.translation: 今天是待在避难所里的第38天，一大早就闹哄哄的。

scripts.text: This morning the recruited Adventurers to join the Chemical Substance Specialists for an investigation outside the air-raid shelter, many volunteered despite the dangers.
scripts.translation: 今天早上，他们招募冒险者和化学物质专家一起去避难所外调查。尽管有危险，还是有很多人自愿参加。

scripts.text: I am of the belief danger should be avoided but my friends Castle and Blat volunteered.
scripts.translation: 我觉得还是避开危险比较好，可我的朋友卡斯尔和布拉特都自愿去了。

scripts.text: Well I understand that they were sick of living in the shelter for a while.
scripts.translation: 不过我也明白，他们在避难所里待腻了。

scripts.text: They have not returned past the afternoon. Verus City leader Fresa has concluded that the people who left are dead.
scripts.translation: 他们直到下午都没回来。维鲁斯城的领袖弗雷萨认定，离开的人已经遇难。

scripts.text: Everybody had a moment of silence at dawn. They were good people so it is sad to part like this.
scripts.translation: 天亮时，大家为他们默哀了一会儿。他们都是好人，想到就此分别，真让人难过。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Is it since the morning of the 40th day? There is a mysterious infectious disease going around the shelter.
scripts.translation: 是从第40天早上开始的吗？避难所里好像出现了一种神秘的传染病。

scripts.text: A few people have suddenly attacked those near them and convulsed
scripts.translation: 有些人突然开始抽搐，还攻击身边的人。

scripts.text: And Adventurers have been deployed to suppress the convulsing people because a lot of the weak researchers are wounded.
scripts.translation: 许多体弱的研究员受了伤，于是派冒险者去制伏那些抽搐的人。

scripts.text: There is a rumor saying a contaminant came in because of the people who went outside the shelter a while go.
scripts.translation: 有人传言，之前离开避难所的人把污染物带了进来。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 没有更多的录音内容了。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再听一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 继续收听

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Lunch during day 44 the air-raid shelter leader Fresa gathered the Adventurers and had a presentation.
scripts.translation: 第44天午餐时，避难所领袖弗雷萨召集冒险者，向大家说明了情况。

scripts.text: The rumor has been confirmed true and a safety partition will be built in Zone Z-0
scripts.translation: 传闻已经得到证实，他们决定在Z-0区建一道隔离墙。

scripts.text: A decision has been made to move necessities to Zone Z-2 tomorrow and I heard they need the help of Adventurers.
scripts.translation: 他们决定明天把必需品转移到Z-2区，听说需要冒险者帮忙。

scripts.text: I have to work tomorrow so I am doing to sleep early.
scripts.translation: 我明天还得工作，今晚早点睡。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 没有更多的录音内容了。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再听一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
I don't know what brings you here but please don't touch anything.
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员 皮克]
我不知道你来这里做什么，不过请别碰任何东西。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
I haven't finished checking the stock and it would be annoying if anything went missing.
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员 皮克]
我还没盘点完库存，要是少了什么东西就麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
You're an adventurer. You don't have to deliver air cleaners here.
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员 皮克]
你是冒险者吧？不用把空气净化设备送到这里。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
It's a warehouse anyway. The independent air circulation system is enough.
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员 皮克]
反正这里是仓库，有独立的空气循环系统就够了。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
Aahh- Looking after the warehouse is annoying.
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员 皮克]
唉...看仓库真烦人。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
There is nobody to rotate my shift
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员 皮克]
没人能替我轮班。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
Wha- wha- wait stop!!
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员 皮克]
什...什...等等，住手！！

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
You're not here to ambush me right? It's alright if not.
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员 皮克]
你不是来偷袭我的吧？不是就好。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
Are you here to move items?
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员 皮克]
你是来搬运物品的吗？

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
The goods in this warehouse should not be today I think? From what I know today we are moving necessities first.
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员 皮克]
今天不该搬这个仓库里的货物吧？我记得今天应该先转移生活必需品。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Hello adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
你好，冒险者？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I don't know the reason, but Fresa assigned me here.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
我也不知道原因，不过弗雷萨把我派到了这里。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I always wondered why I was assigned here but now I think I know the reason.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
我一直纳闷为什么把我派来这里，现在大概明白了。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
It is to watch if the Mechanicians make useless things.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
原来是要监视机械师们有没有又在捣鼓没用的东西。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
The Mechanicians occasionally want to make something.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
机械师们偶尔会想造点什么。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
My job is to stop them.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
我的工作就是拦着他们。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I hear patients these days are convulsing and attacking the people around them?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
我听说最近有些病人会抽搐，还会攻击身边的人？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
The Mechanician constantly convulse saying they want to make something so it's not weird to me.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
机械师们老嚷嚷着要做东西，抽搐起来我倒也不觉得奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
The convulsion of Mechanicians are reaching extremes.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
机械师们抽搐得越来越厉害了。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
They are convulsing so much I may need to call back up.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
他们抽搐得这么厉害，我可能得叫增援了。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Hello adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
你好，冒险者？

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
We are seeing if there are hazardous substances within the air-raid shelter according to emergency protocol.
scripts.translation:
[化学物质专家 科里]
我们正按照紧急协议，排查避难所内是否存在危险物质。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
You want to know how many Chemical Substance Specialists there are? Go to Karsten then. Should be here somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[化学物质专家 科里]
想知道化学物质专家有多少人？去找卡斯滕问问吧，他应该就在附近。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
This next room is temporarily being used by the Chemical Substance Specialist.
scripts.translation:
[化学物质专家 科里]
下一间房暂时由化学物质专家使用。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
We tightly hid away dangerous things but don't touch anything just in case.
scripts.translation:
[化学物质专家 科里]
危险物品都被我们严严实实地藏好了，不过以防万一，还是别碰任何东西。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
Karsten gave me grapes.
scripts.translation:
[化学物质专家 科里]
卡斯滕给了我一些葡萄。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
How fresh and tasty it was.
scripts.translation:
[化学物质专家 科里]
又新鲜又好吃。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
My colleagues left the air-raid shelter to investigate and haven't come back.
scripts.translation:
[化学物质专家 科里]
我的同事们离开避难所去调查，到现在还没回来。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
It was concluded they are dead but are they really all dead? I want to see my colleagues.
scripts.translation:
[化学物质专家 科里]
大家都认定他们已经遇难了，可他们真的全都死了吗？我想再见见我的同事。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
Good work.
scripts.translation:
[化学物质专家 科里]
干得好。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
We are working to find a solution for the contaminant.
scripts.translation:
[化学物质专家 科里]
我们正在设法解决污染问题。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I found this while looking around the air-raid shelter
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 巴姆达库]
我在避难所里四处查看时发现了这个...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
but there is a lot of this on the wall. What can it be?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 巴姆达库]
可墙上到处都是这种东西。到底是什么？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I have been investigating this for 30 days already but I do not know what it is.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 巴姆达库]
我已经调查了30天，还是不知道这是什么。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I am too proud to ask somebody.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 巴姆达库]
我又拉不下脸去问别人。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I have been investigating this for 32 days already but I do not know what it is.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 巴姆达库]
我已经调查32天了，还是不知道这是什么。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
Ugh what to do.. Should I just ask somebody?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 巴姆达库]
唉，该怎么办...要不还是问问别人？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I have been investigating this for 40 days already.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 巴姆达库]
我已经调查40天了。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
My pride won't let me quit now.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 巴姆达库]
我的自尊心不允许我现在放弃。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
45 days have passed since I started investigating this unknown thing.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 巴姆达库]
调查这个未知的东西，已经过去45天了。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
How did I come to investigate this?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 巴姆达库]
我当初为什么会开始调查这个来着？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Dally]
Darn it!! Frustrating
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 达莉]
可恶！！真让人恼火！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Dally]
Sister- Run~
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 达莉]
姐姐，快跑~

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Dally]
Brother- Run~
scripts.translation:
[冒险者 达莉]
哥哥，快跑~
